caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed with a high, ornately curved backrest and sides, all rendered in shades of brown and tan. The main view, shown in color at the top, illustrates the bed with a light yellowish-brown mattress lying on its slatted frame. The bed has four square legs, additional vertical supports along the front, and an elaborate, decorative crest on the backrest. On the right side, there is a small black-and-white sketch labeled "BED IN OPEN POSITION" depicting the transformation or extension of the bed's frame. Below the main colored illustration are three line drawings: one full side view highlighting the detailed scalloped top of the backrest, one front view, and another side view, all drawn in black ink without color. Below these schematic views, a scale is provided, and a signature appears in the lower left corner. The composition is orderly, with the colored perspective at the top and technical line drawings arranged beneath it on a plain, cream background.
title: Settee and Folding Bed
